follows.conclusion: single authority removes contradictions, but legacy semanticRole projection cannot distinguish navigation from region structure

definitions.regionStructure: an occurrence that names or opens a semantic region whose subsequent content belongs beneath it
definitions.navigation: an occurrence that points to, lists, or leads to content elsewhere
definitions.occurrenceNotString: identical or overlapping text may have different functions at different source occurrences and contexts

sourceParts.description: The existing source-coordinate tuple; its binder and canonicalization are unchanged by this design.

semanticFunction.description: The sole authority from which membership is derived.

occurrenceRole.description: Optional descriptive axis; never a membership authority.

scope.description: Optional descriptive axis; never a membership authority.

titleRelation.description: Optional descriptive axis; never a membership authority.

deterministicProofs: isHeading is absent and rejected as a field not in the contract
generic heading is not an enum value and fails closed
membership is derived only from semanticFunction
NAVIGATION, PAGE_FURNITURE, OBJECT_CAPTION, TABLE_STRUCTURE, FOOTNOTE_OR_SOURCE, BODY_INFORMATION and METADATA are nonmembers
the same words can be NAVIGATION in contents and REGION_STRUCTURE in body
sourceParts are preserved verbatim and the existing binder identity is unchanged
V2 remains production default and its committed raw run remains a historical input
nextGate: Do not create or send V4 until this frozen decision shape is reviewed; a future arm must use this closed vocabulary rather than project legacy semanticRole.
